intro: Rethiel the Greenwarden is an enigmatic presence residing deep within the Green Belt of the Wetlands. He is tied to the marsh's uneasy balance and calls on travelers to deal with the threats that disrupt it.

p: Rethiel seeks to alleviate the suffering of the Wetlands by dispatching sympathetic adventurers against its major agitators. He urges visitors to hunt down destructive Mosshide gnolls who ravage the wildlife, strip them of the crude flints they use to burn the marsh's living trees, and thin out the diseased fen creepers that fester in the marsh waters. Through these cullings, he hopes to restore peace to the wounded soil.
